_comment: The direction audit (PLAN-todo-tool.md §5, §8 decision 4): todo never reads the delegation layer's files and never names a roster agent; items name repos, not agents. devtools/audit.py fails on any match in any file of this repo outside `skip`. The roster names below are the ones that are not also repo names; they are a copy, taken 2026-10-04, and a new roster agent needs adding here by hand (TODO.md records that this copy can go stale: the tool may not read the roster to refresh it).
_skip: fixtures are other repos' text; audit.json, test_audit.py and mutants.json hold the terms and the planted violations that prove the audit can fail; .claude/hooks/ and .claude/lib/ hold the shared copies setup's hooks component installs, the renderer's files and not this repo's code, gated by `hooks copies` (td-16, Jacob 2026-10-05); .progress/ is the parts runner's progress file and per-part logs (gitignored, never committed), which quote other tools' output verbatim (2026-10-15: checks.log quoted hooks-installed's paths and turned the audit red)

patterns.why: the interim-rules register (a later harness job reads todo, not the reverse)
the owner resolver: the mapping from repo+work to an agent stays outside todo

accepted.line: "resolution": "stale: checked 2026-10-15: every store in the scan (top level, income, context-hygiene, todo) is format 2 and sealed; store-guard's .claude/lib/extra-stores.sh holds todo.json and todo-history.json at any repo root without a cli.json declaring them (tools/hooks b7a8c6b)",
accepted.why: td-28's resolution (fd52be9) names the installed copy's path, which this repo carries under .claude/lib/ (skipped above), not a read of the delegation layer; history is append-only, so the line stays (2026-10-15)

accepted.line: "resolution": "answered from PLAN-services.md §3, planner 2026-10-20 (Jacob, relay line 300): cli.json's eight entries stand; step 10.1 removes them with verify --json; tl-503 closed by the planner",
accepted.why: td-89's resolution (6dc62a4), text given verbatim by the dispatch, names the roster agent that relayed Jacob's answer; committed and pushed before the audit ran, and history is append-only, so the line stays (2026-10-20)

_accepted: single lines that hit a term and cannot be changed (an append-only history entry): file and exact stripped text; audit.py fails an entry that matches no line, or a line that hits no term
